family: The single total AND family defined in proof.md: f_0(empty)=1; for n>=1, f_n(x) is the AND of all n bits of x. The language is L={x : f_|x|(x)=1}, decided by one fixed linear-time evaluator with empty witnesses as specified in proof.md.
theorem: For this one total uniform polynomial-time family, hence in NP with empty witnesses, C_B2(f_n)>=n-1=(1)n^1-1 at every integer length n>=1, so liminf C_B2(f_n)/n>=1 in the full Li-Yang B2 model at actual input length n=|x|.
